verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a general 'transaction rules' engine that can auto-approve/decline authorizations, and a relayed-authorization webhook that lets ops apply custom real-time decision logic (including presumably MCC or merchant data available in the transaction) — but the evidence never explicitly names MCC allowlist/blocklist fields or single-merchant lock as configurable rule types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC-based allow/block rule fields, single-merchant lock configuration, and any UI/API example showing these specific spend-control types being applied at authorization time.
